name: Baroness von Hoffman
bio: The Baroness von Hoffman and the Baron returned from a western trip in their special car on September 25, 1884. That month the paper corrected an earlier report about a new brick cottage she was building.

moments.label: Returned from a western trip in her special car

mentions: The Baron and Baroness von Hoffman are expected to return from their western trip in a few days.
We were misinformed last week in regard to the new brick cottage the Baroness von Hoffmann is building. Mr. Grymes is the happy recipient of the Baroness' valuable present.
The Baron and Baroness von Hoffmann returned from their western trip this morning in their special car.
